references.referencePurpose: Primary topology, district composition, route hierarchy and elevation-layering constraint.
requiredLayoutPrinciples: downtown across the north and centre
port in the northeast and east
waterfront route along the south and southeast
compact flyover junction linking downtown, main route and waterfront
one legible connected road system rather than scattered test tracks
elementsThatCannotFitLiterally: the reference island's full building count
the reference's apparent multi-kilometre road length
fully separated industrial yards and downtown superblocks
references.compressionPlan: Use one 500 x 350 metre island footprint, a single continuous main loop, one cross-city commercial spine, one compact two-ramp flyover, a short underpass, and five tightly adjacent route identities. Occlusion, elevation and water preserve the reference hierarchy without copying every road.

road markings and edges appropriate to each class

references.compressionPlan: Reduce speed and lane count while preserving the relative road hierarchy, safety treatment, readable curve radius and vehicle-clearance ratios.

globalCompressionRules: Use most of the 500 x 350 metre footprint.
Compress road length through adjacency, not repeated self-looping.
Use one grade-separated flyover and one short underpass rather than a full motorway interchange.
Preserve water, terrain and skyline as route-framing masses.
Keep all buildings, vegetation, signs and props as non-final proxies.
